info.title: Swissdec Qualitytool API
info.description:
Authentication

This API requires basic authentication (RFC 7617)

Usage Examples

Example for automized KLE Tests

  1. Reset and load desired references through API (example: kle-reset-run-and-load-tf01-uvg)
  2. Assert the score is zero with provided report from Step 1
  3. Transmit data to the IncidentDeclarationService
  4. Get and assert the desired score through API (kle-report)
  5. Submit or archive run if desired (kle-submit-run or kle-archive-run)
  6. For another run, or different references, start again with Step 1

Example for automized ELM Tests

  1. Reset and load desired references through API (example: elm-reset-run-and-load-v5-de)
  2. Assert the score is zero with provided report from Step 1
  3. Transmit data to the SalaryDeclarationService
  4. Get and assert the desired score through API (elm-report)
  5. Archive run if desired (elm-archive-run)
  6. For another run, or different references, start again with Step 1

If you wish to keep your current references, you can do so by only reseting your requests (elm-reset-requests or kle-reset-requests)
